stance_basis: accepted Scheme A while providing conditions on playfield status and compensation for school property
summary: Board of Education District No. 170 participated in early coordination regarding the Roosevelt School property and Section 4(f) land involvement, ultimately determining that the school playfield was not significant for recreational purposes. The Board also conducted a review during preparation of the Final Statement that helped resolve the Section 4(f) question for the Roosevelt School property. Their involvement was central to resolving compensation and landscaping arrangements for the right-of-way taken from the school yard.
complaint_summary: Board of Education District No. 170 is listed as one of the agencies from whom opinions were requested regarding possible Lincoln Highway/Section 4(f) land involvement with the Roosevelt School property.
summary_quote: At the regular board meeting of Wednesday, January 12, 1972, the Board of Education unamimously accepted the Building Committee's recommendation to accept Scheme A as submitted by the Department of Public Works and Buildings.

mentions.quote: 5(a) The playfield is a grassed area and not used for formal recreation.
